The beneficiaries list is complete in `src/screens/Screen.tsx` and `src/screens/Screen.module.css`.

**What's built:**
- A table of 6 mock beneficiaries (name, bank, masked last-4 account digits, date added).
- Per-row checkbox selection plus a header "select all" checkbox (with indeterminate state).
- A sticky "N selected" bar with an icon+label "Remove selected" button that appears only when selection is non-empty.
- Sortable "Name" and "Added" column headers (click to sort, click again to reverse direction), with an arrow indicator.
- Icon-only Edit (pencil) and Remove (trash) buttons per row; Edit switches the row into an inline editable form (name/bank) with Save/Cancel icon buttons.
- Uses only CSS custom properties from `@strata/tokens` (with sensible fallbacks) and logical CSS properties, so it should adapt across brands, light/dark, density, and RTL locales without depending on the `@strata/react`/`@strata/icons` JS APIs — which I avoided importing since `node_modules` isn't installed in this sandbox and I couldn't verify their exact exports without leaving the working folder.

One note: I couldn't run the dev server or typecheck since no tools for that are available here, so please run `pnpm install && pnpm dev`/`pnpm typecheck` to verify.
